Julian Woods is a former English cricketer born on April 28, 1972, in Nottingham, England. He is primarily known as a right-handed batsman and occasional right-arm medium-fast bowler.

Woods played for Nottinghamshire County Cricket Club, where he had a significant role in the team during his career. He was known for his versatility as a player, being able to contribute in both batting and bowling departments, although his primary focus was on batting.

His first-class career spanned from 1991 to 2002, during which he made over 100 appearances. Woods also played limited-overs cricket, featuring in one-day matches and contributing to the shorter format of the game.

After retiring from professional cricket, Woods has been involved in various coaching roles and has contributed to the development of young cricketers in different capacities.
